verdicts.reason: Neither candidate fills the canvas: the photo is letterboxed, which leaves big empty white bands above and below it. A also puts the white F logo right on the car's windshield, where it collides with the busy image, though its headline and the /FR links sit on darker ground at the bottom and stay readable. B is worse: its light-grey logo hangs half off the photo onto the white band, so part of it nearly disappears, and the FORCE ROGUE headline is laid across the red car roof and spoiler. That busy background hurts legibility, and the links are crammed against the right edge.
